SELECT SEQ_PROJ_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_PROJECT ( PROJ_ID, CHTRM_ID, PROJ_NM, PROJ_CN, PROJ_BGNG_YMD, PROJ_END_YMD, PROJ_STAT_CD, PROJ_CREAT_DT, PROJ_LDR_EMP_ID, PROJ_PRGRS_RT ) VALUES ( #{projId}, #{chtrmId}, #{projNm}, #{projCn}, #{projBgngYmd}, #{projEndYmd}, '01', SYSDATE, #{projLdrEmpId}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT P.PROJ_ID, P.PROJ_NM, P.PROJ_BGNG_YMD, P.PROJ_END_YMD, CASE WHEN P.PROJ_STAT_CD = '01' AND P.PROJ_BGNG_YMD <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '02' ELSE P.PROJ_STAT_CD END AS PROJ_STAT_CD, E.EMP_NM AS PROJ_LDR_NM, P.PROJ_PRGRS_RT FROM TB_PROJECT P JOIN TB_PROJ_MEMBER PM ON PM.PROJ_ID = P.PROJ_ID AND PM.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND PM.LEAVE_DT IS NULL JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMP_ID = P.PROJ_LDR_EMP_ID ORDER BY P.PROJ_CREAT_DT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PROJECT SET PROJ_STAT_CD = '02', PROJ_STAT_CHG_DT = SYSDATE WHERE PROJ_STAT_CD = '01' AND TRUNC(PROJ_BGNG_YMD) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT P.PROJ_ID, P.PROJ_NM, P.PROJ_CN, P.PROJ_BGNG_YMD, P.PROJ_END_YMD, CASE WHEN P.PROJ_STAT_CD = '01' AND P.PROJ_BGNG_YMD <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '02' ELSE P.PROJ_STAT_CD END AS PROJ_STAT_CD, P.PROJ_LDR_EMP_ID, P.PROJ_PRGRS_RT, LDR.EMP_NM AS PROJ_LDR_NM, PM.EMP_ID, E.EMP_NM, D.DEPT_NM FROM TB_PROJECT P JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE LDR ON LDR.EMP_ID = P.PROJ_LDR_EMP_ID JOIN TB_PROJ_MEMBER PM ON PM.PROJ_ID = P.PROJ_ID AND PM.LEAVE_DT IS NULL JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMP_ID = PM.EMP_ID JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD WHERE P.PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PROJ_MEMBER WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND EMP_ID = #{empId} AND LEAVE_DT IS NULL )
mapper.update:
UPDATE TB_PROJECT
PROJ_NM = #{projNm}, PROJ_CN = #{projCn}, PROJ_BGNG_YMD = #{projBgngYmd}, PROJ_END_YMD = #{projEndYmd}, PROJ_STAT_CD = #{projStatCd}, PROJ_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE,
PROJ_STAT_CHG_DT = SYSDATE,
WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId}

UPDATE TB_PROJECT SET PROJ_PRGRS_RT = ( SELECT ROUND( NVL( SUM(T.TASK_PRGRS_SMRY * CASE T.TASK_IMPRTNC_CD WHEN '01' THEN 1 WHEN '02' THEN 2 WHEN '03' THEN 3 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE T.TASK_IMPRTNC_CD WHEN '01' THEN 1 WHEN '02' THEN 2 WHEN '03' THEN 3 END), 0) * 100 , 0) ) FROM TB_TASK T WHERE T.PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND T.DEL_YN = 'N' ) WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId}
mapper.select: SELECT P.PROJ_ID, P.PROJ_NM, PM.EMP_ID AS M_EMP_ID FROM TB_PROJECT P JOIN TB_PROJ_MEMBER PM ON PM.PROJ_ID = P.PROJ_ID AND PM.LEAVE_DT IS NULL WHERE P.PROJ_STAT_CD = '02' AND TRUNC(P.PROJ_END_YMD) = TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1)
